objects.workingCapitalProduct: one seeded product (id 1, SEED-WC-Product) — captured in loan-products-list-raw.json
objects.workingCapitalLoan: one seeded loan (id 1, externalId SEED-WC-L01, status loanStatusType.active, principal 1000.51) — captured in loans-list-raw.json and wc-loan-detail-raw.json

readBackQuirks.loans: GET /working-capital-loans returns {"content":[ one loan ],"totalElements":1} for the seeded loan (loans-list-raw.json).
readBackQuirks.loanDetail: GET /working-capital-loans/1 returns the single loan with principal 1000.51, balance 1000.51 outstanding, and an EIR amortization read (periodPaymentAmount 0.03, numberOfRepayments 33351) — the EIR/amortization solver is not ported in the Go module, so no cell from it is graded (wc-loan-detail-raw.json).
readBackQuirks.nearBreach: GET /working-capital/near-breach returns [] because no breach/delinquency range is configured on the seed (near-breach-list-raw.json).
readBackQuirks.writePath: The seed was written through POST /working-capital-loan-products (wc-product-create), POST /working-capital-loans (wc-loan-submit), and the approve/disburse commands on /working-capital-loans/1 (wc-loan-approve, wc-loan-disburse).
readBackQuirks.unreachable: The breach-schedule and delinquency-range-schedule seams (/working-capital-loans/{loanId}/breach-schedule and /delinquency-range-schedule) are still unreachable: the seed configures no breach/delinquency range, so the schedule reads would be empty and declaring them exercised would be a fabricated observation.
